name: Mission Bottom Produce
description: Mission Bottom Produce grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 5500 Block Windsor Island Rd, OR. The farm is small, and its seasons run through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
